description: This file defines the 'Profile' class within the Twig template engine's profiler component. The class provides functionality to profile template rendering durations, memory usage, and nested profiles, mainly used for debugging and performance analysis of Twig templates.

classes.name: Profile
classes.description: Represents a profiling node in Twig's profiling hierarchy, capturing timing, memory, and nested profiles for a specific template, block, macro, or the root.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Returns the name of the template associated with this profile.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of profile, such as 'ROOT', 'block', 'template', or 'macro'.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the profile, often the block or macro name.

methods.name: isRoot
methods.description: Checks if this profile is the root profile.

methods.name: isTemplate
methods.description: Checks if this profile is of type 'template'.

methods.name: isBlock
methods.description: Checks if this profile is of type 'block'.

methods.name: isMacro
methods.description: Checks if this profile is of type 'macro'.

methods.name: getProfiles
methods.description: Returns nested profiles.

methods.name: addProfile
methods.description: Adds a nested profile.

methods.name: getDuration
methods.description: Calculates the total duration in microseconds, summing child profiles if root.

methods.name: getStartTime
methods.description: Returns the start time in microseconds.

methods.name: getEndTime
methods.description: Returns the end time in microseconds.

methods.name: getMemoryUsage
methods.description: Returns the current memory usage difference in bytes.

methods.name: getPeakMemoryUsage
methods.description: Returns the peak memory usage difference in bytes.

methods.name: enter
methods.description: Starts profiling by recording start times and memory usage.

methods.name: leave
methods.description: Stops profiling by recording end times and memory usage.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets profiling data and starts new profiling.

methods.name: getIterator
methods.description: Iterator over nested profiles.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes the profile object.

methods.name: unserialize
methods.description: Unserializes data into the profile object.

methods.name: __serialize
methods.description: Internal method to represent object state for serialization.

methods.name: __unserialize
methods.description: Internal method to restore object state from serialized data.
